culprit_citations.quoted_text: Total United States of America 1st Lien/Secured Loans | 801,020,176 | 783,000,934 | 144.49

rationale: Class 3 aggregate review. The apparent violations are percent-of-net-assets values above 100%, but the raw filing itself prints those values in the % of Net Assets column, including 144.49, 151.53, 154.82%, and Total Investments at 164.48%. For a leveraged BDC schedule, investment fair value can exceed net assets, so magnitude above 100% is not by itself a data error. The extracted values match the source schedule rather than contradicting it.
